title: helianthemum origanifolium var. marifolium
intro: Helianthemum origanifolium var. marifolium, commonly known as Rockrose or Dwarf Rockrose, is a flowering plant species within the Cistaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm and relax, making it useful for treating anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum origanifolium var. marifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
